title: Bayesian Complete-Pooling in Cross-Subject Classification for Motor Imagery Electroencephalogram
abstract: arXiv:2607.22980v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) have long sought calibration-free operation, yet classifiers are typically benchmarked on discrimination alone. Discrimination is blind to calibration, a meaningful gap given that electroencephalogram (EEG) signals are nonstationary and point-estimate classifiers can become overconfident under distribution shift. We conducted a large-scale study contrasting Bayesian complete-pooling models against frequentist baselines for cross-subject, left-hand versus right-hand motor imagery EEG classification across 20 datasets. Each of six frequentist pipelines was paired with an analogous Bayesian pipeline sharing identical, deterministic feature extraction, so that only the classifier was Bayesian. Bayesian classifiers were fit via Markov chain Monte Carlo. translated_title: 运动想象脑电图中跨被试分类的贝叶斯完全池化方法
translated_abstract: 脑机接口（BCI）长期以来一直追求免校准操作，然而分类器通常仅以判别能力作为评估基准。判别能力对校准问题视而不见——考虑到脑电（EEG）信号具有非平稳性，且点估计分类器在分布偏移下可能变得过度自信，这一差距不容忽视。我们开展了一项大规模研究，在20个数据集上对比了贝叶斯完全池化模型与频率学派基线方法在跨被试左右手运动想象脑电分类任务中的表现。六个频率学派流水线中的每一个均与一个对应的贝叶斯流水线配对，两者共享完全相同的确定性特征提取过程，从而确保只有分类器部分是贝叶斯的。贝叶斯分类器通过马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）方法进行拟合。我们的主要评估指标为Brier评分（并分解为可靠性与分辨率两个部分），同时结合ROC曲线下面积（AUC）衡量判别能力以及香农熵……
tldr: 该论文通过在20个数据集上的大规模对比研究发现，在特征提取完全相同的条件下，贝叶斯完全池化分类器在跨被试运动想象脑电分类中相比频率学派点估计基线能提供更优的校准性与可靠性，从而缓解了分布偏移下的过度自信问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a large-scale study across 20 datasets demonstrating that, with identical deterministic feature extraction, Bayesian complete-pooling classifiers outperform frequentist point-estimate baselines in calibration and reliability for cross-subject motor imagery EEG classification.
